definitions: Be given, presented with, or paid (something).
Experience or be subjected to (something, typically something unpleasant).
Allow (something) to enter or be introduced.
Convert (a broadcast signal) into sound or pictures.
Formally admit (someone) to a group or society.
examples: I received a letter from him.
The country received a major setback.
She received guests in her home.
He was received into the church.
He was charged with receiving stolen goods.
